entities.name: Edgur
entities.description: Man from Epityr, apprentice coppersmith in Argivia, who turned into a bear and killed Joren.

entities.name: Joren
entities.description: Rival courter who defeated Edgur in a duel and was killed by him.

entities.name: Dare
entities.description: Nature spirit who offered Edgur an emerald that turns him into a bear.

entities.name: Argivia
entities.description: Place where Edgur worked as an apprentice.

events.summary: Joren easily defeated Edgur in a duel over Riliana.
events.quote: Joren , who easily defeated Edgur in a duel

events.summary: Dare offered Edgur healing and an emerald that could turn him into a bear.
events.quote: an emerald that could turn Edgur into a bear

events.summary: Edgur turned into a bear and slaughtered Joren, his men and patrons of the tavern.
events.quote: He returned to the inn, slaughtering Joren and his men

events.summary: The townsfolk killed Edgur and Riliana learned the bear was Edgur.

relations.quote: After falling in love with a woman named Riliana
